Figure 9. Speciﬁc capacity of SSB cells with (a), (b) PC-NCM and (c), (d) SC-NCM as CAM. The cells were cycled with (a), (c) 0.1C in the potential range 2.6–4.25 V vs Li+/Li (low-V) or with (b), (d) 0.3C in the potential range 2.6–4.5 V vs Li+/Li (high-V) over 40 cycles. The total measured capacity is shown as a bold line. Individual contributions to the capacity fading, such as the loss of active mass (obtained from OCP relaxation) and the increased length of the pathway of lithium diffusion (obtained from EIS-PSD), are depicted as a thin line and symbols, respectively.
